trailhead.label: The old bridge in Toscolano, Toscolano Maderno, the published start

cautions: The first half is the asphalt Via Valle delle Cartiere, open to cars going to the museum: keep your dog on a short lead there.
The ruins of the mills are fragile and the stream runs beside the path: keep your dog out of the ruins and away from the water after rain.
A low valley by Lake Garda: in high summer go early, though the gorge is mostly shaded.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The ruins of the mills are fragile and t: I ruderi delle cartiere sono fragili e il torrente scorre accanto al sentiero: tenete il cane fuori dai ruderi e lontano dall’acqua dopo la pioggia.
textIt.A low valley by Lake Garda: in high summ: Una valle bassa vicino al Lago di Garda: in piena estate partite presto, anche se la gola è quasi tutta all’ombra.
